profile.headline: Software Engineer - Xcode Intelligence - Partnerships at Apple
profile.summary:
My journey began at age 11 when I wrote my first line of Swift code. That early fascination has evolved into my current role as a Software Engineer at Apple, where I help drive the future of the Xcode application itself. I specialize in building intelligence foundations, integrating complex AI systems directly into the developer workflow.

My technical work is deeply rooted in system architecture, requiring advanced concurrency, multithreading, and the implementation of Large Language Models (LLMs). While I primarily develop in Swift, my role utilizes a versatile command of languages including Objective-C, JavaScript, Python, and Rust to navigate the complexities of modern developer tools.

I hold a B.S. in Computer Science and Electrical Engineering from Stanford University. During my time there, I served as President of the Nu Sigma Chapter of Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc., an experience that cemented my belief that true innovation requires both technical excellence and strong, empathetic leadership. Whether architecting complex systems or collaborating with my team, I am driven to build tools that empower the next generation of developers.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Xcode Intelligence - Partnerships
positions.description: Software Engineer on Apple’s Xcode Intelligence Partnerships team, working with frontier labs to integrate agentic software into Apple's developer tools and frameworks.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Xcode Intelligence - Foundations
positions.description: Software Engineer on Apple’s Xcode Intelligence Foundations team, building agentic AI integrations for Apple's developer tools and frameworks from the ground up.

positions.title: Machine Learning Research Intern
positions.description: Research at the intersection of human-computer interaction, machine learning, and programming languages. Developed several prototypes for experimental, Generative Al-based, developer technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Software engineering intern with with Apple’s Developer Technologies team. Improved developer applications (i.e. Xcode) through collaborative feature development. Constructed the Xcode "Sticky Headers" feature and "Bookmarks Navigator" from the ground up.

honors.title: Stanford University Award of Excellence
honors.description: Designed to recognize the top 10% of the class, the Award of Excellence honors graduating seniors who have demonstrated a sincere commitment to the university through involvement, leadership and extraordinary Stanford spirit.
honors.issuer: Issued by Stanford University Alumni Association · May 2024

honors.title: WWDC Swift Student Challenge Winner
honors.description: Submitted a Swift (programming language) implementation of a deep learning project and received high recognition for my work.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. develops leaders, promotes brotherhood and academic excellence, while providing service and advocacy for our communities.

Our objectives are:
• to stimulate the ambition of its members
• to prepare them for the greatest usefulness in the causes of humanity, freedom, and dignity of the individual
• to encourage the highest and noblest form of manhood
• to aid downtrodden humanity in its efforts to achieve higher social, economic and intellectual status

projects.title: Stanny: Application of Natural Language Deep Learning Concepts
projects.description: Stanny is an implementation of custom built natural language processing deep learning models. Over 4,000 lines of personally created conversational data have been used in development of the Keras models used to create Stanny.
